CREATE TABLE stock_loss_disposition_reversals (
	reversed_correction_id CHAR(32), 
	original_transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	original_movement_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	posting_transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	posting_movement_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_account_id CHAR(32), 
	target_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	custody_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	plan_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_disposition_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	command_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_request UNIQUE (actor_user_id, request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_root UNIQUE (id, root_disposition_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_inverse_context CHECK (authorization_version > 0 AND length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_inverse_request CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 160 AND length(idempotency_key_hash)=64 AND length(request_hash)=64), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_inverse_correction_root FOREIGN KEY(reversed_correction_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_executions (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_correction UNIQUE (reversed_correction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_original_tx UNIQUE (original_transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_original_move UNIQUE (original_movement_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_posted_tx UNIQUE (posting_transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_inverse_posted_move UNIQUE (posting_movement_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_inverse_posting CHECK (quantity > 0 AND original_transaction_id <> posting_transaction_id AND original_movement_id <> posting_movement_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_inverse_accounts CHECK (source_account_id IS NULL OR source_account_id <> target_account_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_inverse_plan CHECK (length(plan_hash)=64), 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_movement_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_movement_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_dispositions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE stock_loss_correction_decisions (
	reversal_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	expected_reversal_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	disposition VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_disposition_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	command_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_decision_request UNIQUE (actor_user_id, request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_decision_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_decision_root UNIQUE (id, root_disposition_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_decision_context CHECK (authorization_version > 0 AND length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_decision_request CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 160 AND length(idempotency_key_hash)=64 AND length(request_hash)=64), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_correction_decision_inverse_root FOREIGN KEY(reversal_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_disposition_reversals (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_decision_binding UNIQUE (id, root_disposition_id, reversal_id, disposition), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_decision_kind CHECK (disposition IN ('restore_available','convert_used','convert_damaged','return_to_region','scrap')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_decision_hash CHECK (length(expected_reversal_hash)=64), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_dispositions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE stock_loss_request_key_bindings (
	fact_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	binding_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	root_disposition_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	key_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reversal_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	approval_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	correction_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	inverse_id CHAR(32), 
	approval_id CHAR(32), 
	correction_id CHAR(32), 
	seal_id CHAR(32), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (fact_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_request_binding_request UNIQUE (actor_user_id, request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_key_token_key UNIQUE (key_token), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_reversal_key_hash_key UNIQUE (reversal_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_approval_key_hash_key UNIQUE (approval_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_correction_key_hash_key UNIQUE (correction_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_inverse FOREIGN KEY(inverse_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_disposition_reversals (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_approval FOREIGN KEY(approval_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_decisions (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_correction FOREIGN KEY(correction_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_executions (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_seal FOREIGN KEY(seal_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_inverse_request_seals (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_request_binding_kind CHECK ((binding_kind='inverse' AND inverse_id=fact_id AND inverse_id IS NOT NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='approval' AND approval_id=fact_id AND approval_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='correction' AND correction_id=fact_id AND correction_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='inverse_seal' AND seal_id=fact_id AND seal_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_request_binding_digests CHECK ((length(request_hash)=64 AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(key_token)=64 AND key_token NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(reversal_key_hash)=64 AND reversal_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(approval_key_hash)=64 AND approval_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(correction_key_hash)=64 AND correction_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND reversal_key_hash<>approval_key_hash AND reversal_key_hash<>correction_key_hash AND approval_key_hash<>correction_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_request_binding_request CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 160 AND request_id NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._:-]*'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_dispositions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
